placements.title: Operational Reliability and Resilience Verification
placements.frame: How are system recovery procedures and operational failure modes tested and verified?

placements.title: Unrehearsed Rollback Is An Illusory Capability
placements.frame: Why must recovery procedures be actively rehearsed on a regular schedule to be counted as actual operational capabilities?
placements.why: Quinton establishes the foundational principle that an unrehearsed rollback does not actually exist, mandating monthly rehearsals for Atlas.
